mentions.name: Hence
mentions.description: A free online daily logic puzzle game, a modern twist on Einstein's puzzle that uses picture clues instead of text. Everyone gets the same puzzle each day, and each puzzle is run through a verifier to ensure it is always solvable by pure deduction without guessing, with a hint system to assist players. No account is needed to play.
mentions.source_excerpt: Hence (https://hencegame.com) is a modern twist on Einstein's puzzle, with fun picture clues instead of text. It's a free online daily puzzle, the same for everyone, where every puzzle is always solvable by pure deduction with no guessing.
